title: Arrears of Listing Fees
text: Home »Legal»Circulars Arrears of Listing Fees Nov 26, 1992| Circulars Ref. SE/11859 November 26, 1992 To, The Presidents/Executive Directors Bombay, Ahmedabad, Calcutta, New Delhi, Hyderabad, Indore, Bangalore, Cochin, Kanpur Pune, Ludhiana, Guwahati Mangalore, Patna, Jaipur Bhubaneshwar, Rajkot, Vadodara Dear Sir, Arrears of Listing Fees You are hereby advised to submit the following information IMMEDIATELY on the receipt of this letter. 1. Total arrears for listing fees; 2. Period-wise analysis of arrears of listing fees; 3. Arrears due Current Arrears of more More to revised Year than 1 year but than 4. Fees Fees upto 3 years 3 years 5. No. of Companies 6. Amount (Rs. In lacs) 7. Action initiated by the exchange against the erring companies. Kindly acknowledge the receipt of this letter. Yours faithfully, sd/- Chandrashekhar Tilak
